type.note: Roboto Flex, bundled in the APK as a font resource (OFL-1.1). Never the downloadable-fonts provider: it goes through Google Play Services and the network. Minimum size anywhere is 13sp; body text is never under 16sp. Sunlight theme adds +100 weight (Roboto Flex is variable).

styles.name: glance-numeral
styles.usage: The one number that matters on a screen: panic-hold countdown, minutes left in a report detail.

styles.name: glance-title
styles.usage: Report type in its detail sheet ("Tear gas"). Readable at arm's length.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Sheet titles for destructive or important flows (wipe, join).

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Default body. The smallest size for any sentence.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Pin badges, map scale. The floor: nothing is smaller.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between two touch targets (gloves are imprecise).

radius.note: Zapper's radius scale minus the key styles. Pin shapes carry meaning, so they are not user-selectable.

shadow.note: Tonal elevation only on the map; one shadow for sheets so they read above a busy map.

size.note: Street sizes. Zapper's touch-min is 56dp for eyes-on-TV use; here it is 64dp because gloves and cold or shaking hands miss more (SPEC NFR-11 asks for at least 56dp).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area of anything tappable, including map pins.

tokens.name: touch-comfort
tokens.usage: Buttons in sheets, list rows, picker tiles' minimum height.

tokens.name: touch-hero
tokens.usage: The Report FAB and the panic-hold button.

tokens.name: pin-size
tokens.usage: Visual size of a report pin; its hit area is touch-min.

tokens.name: pin-halo
tokens.usage: Separation ring around every pin, in pin-halo colour; group reports use their group colour instead.

tokens.name: expiry-ring
tokens.usage: Stroke of the time-left ring around a pin.

tokens.name: thumb-zone
tokens.usage: Fraction of screen height, from the bottom, that holds every frequent action.

opacity.note: M3 state layers plus the 'probably gone' fade (SPEC FR-6.4).

tokens.name: probably-gone
tokens.usage: Pin and label when dismissals outweigh confirmations. The pin stays tappable.

tokens.name: scrim-opacity
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets: stronger than Zapper's 0.32 so a sheet reads clearly over a busy map.

discreet.note: Behaviour tokens for discreet mode, read by the theme, not by components.

tokens.name: discreet-brightness
tokens.usage: Window brightness override (0..1) while discreet mode is on and the app is in front.

tokens.name: discreet-sound
tokens.usage: The app never plays sounds in any mode; listed for completeness.
